npc-plaza: Oh, a visitor! Welcome to Abderrahmane's World!
Every building here tells a piece of their story. The Workshop up north-east has all the projects.
Press M to open the map, or ask me for a guided tour at the sign!
npc-garden: Each plant is a skill. The taller it grows, the more Abderrahmane has practised it.
Walk up to a plant and press E to look closer.
npc-dock: Ahoy. The fish are picky today.
Try the end of the dock if you fancy a catch.
I heard there's a crystal hidden somewhere behind the trees in the south-west...
npc-jogger: Oh hey! I'm on lap number... I lost count.
Fun fact: Abderrahmane built this whole island in code. Even the waves!
Have you tried rowing the little boat at the dock? Rumour says there's an island out there with treasure.
